authorInstruction: 以后不需要生成 GIF；接下来导入到 Unity，文件夹命名为 BuildFX。

texture.name: BuildFX_StaticAtlas.png
texture.format: RGBA8 straight alpha; sRGB color; three static smoke stamps, one glow stamp, solid-color palette; not a flipbook
texture.compression: Uncompressed baseline; device budget not set

nativeMapping.smoke: 17 one-burst native particles: original lifetimes, analytic position derivatives sampled into native velocity curves, original static puff painter; size/alpha/rotation modules.
nativeMapping.flash: Source front/back polygon painters captured into triangulated Mesh particles, native size and alpha curves; three timed pulses. No flash animation atlas.
nativeMapping.arcs: Original thin sweep geometry, fixed local XY mesh rather than View billboard; native expansion/fade approximates the analytic sweep.
nativeMapping.sparks: Original star mesh, native burst/box spawn/velocity/force, size and alpha envelope.
nativeMapping.debris: Original two gray chip meshes, native burst/box/drag-approximation curves/gravity/rotation/fade.
nativeMapping.glow: Actual original radial glow, separate additive native particle; no Light components.

differences: Fixed-plane 2.5D effect: root XY is the reference view; not a volumetric cannon or world-XZ ring.
Flash decay is approximated with native nonuniform scale; its main contours/colors use the approved painter.
Arc expansion scales the approved static sweep rather than recomputing each ribbon vertex over time.
Stars/chips use native seeded spawn ranges; their individual original random identities/birth jitter are not reproduced.
Unity linear-space alpha/additive mixing differs from Canvas; visual calibration is validated separately.
